_comment: Minimum acceptable MEDIAN Lighthouse performance score (0-1) per URL, checked by ci-gate.js against `shopify theme dev` on a CI runner (NOT production -- the dev render is slower/heavier, so these sit well below baseline.json). Calibrated 2026-09-06 from run 33991882319 medians: home m/d 0.61/0.82, product 0.57/0.89, collection 0.60/0.85. Floors are set ~15-20 pts under those to absorb the documented product/home mobile flap -- this is a gross-regression guard, not a quality bar. Field data in baseline.json is the real perf source of truth. Re-check after any deliberate perf work.
